info.title: Lead Fennec AI API
info.description: Generated from packages/shared/src/contracts/endpoints.ts; do not edit by hand. Browsers reach the auth, workspaces, invitations and platform routes through the web app's same-origin proxy at /api. Every response is JSON with Cache-Control: no-store; errors use the ApiError envelope. x-access, x-permission, x-cache and x-invalidates describe who may call a route and how the web app caches its data.
